subject.title: [Bug]: Managed Memory Dreaming Promotion cron silently NO_REPLY since 2026-05-09 (jobs.json lastRun stays null)

question: How should managed Memory Dreaming cron report per-workspace failure or all-workspace no-op outcomes to users and scheduler state?
rationale: The remaining behavior is not just a code bug: marking these handled plugin failures as cron errors, degraded diagnostics, doctor warnings, or memory-health events changes the visible cron/status contract.

options.title: Add degraded diagnostics
options.body: Keep cron execution ok for the outer job but surface failed/no-op Dreaming workspaces in cron diagnostics, doctor, and memory health so users can see the maintenance failure.

options.title: Promote all-failed sweeps to cron error
options.body: Treat all-workspace Dreaming failure as a cron error with failure alerts/backoff while partial failures remain diagnostic.

options.title: Close after storage fixes
options.body: Accept the current SQLite and structured-event fixes as sufficient and leave remaining visibility to logs/events only.

recommendation.title: Add degraded diagnostics
recommendation.body: Keep cron execution ok for the outer job but surface failed/no-op Dreaming workspaces in cron diagnostics, doctor, and memory health so users can see the maintenance failure.

likelyOwner.reason: The shipped SQLite-state fix and overlapping issue closures make steipete the clearest owner for deciding whether the remaining visibility contract is complete.
